verdict.rationale: Slack's Workflow Builder supports no-code automations with triggers (including webhook triggers that fire from outside Slack) and conditional branching, and the Events API lets external apps/bots be invoked automatically ('Slack calls you') to react to workspace events—together these let a user set up automations that run in the background without manual re-invocation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of unattended runs, and explicit support for scheduled/cron-style recurring triggers beyond webhook/event triggers.
